rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AgentShield Guard provides a detection layer for AI agent workflows, classifying incoming text to identify prompt injection, jailbreak, and data-exfiltration attempts before they reach the language model. The server operates as a managed API service with sub-100ms latency and achieves F1 0.921 on a benchmark of 5,972 samples. The Python SDK is distributed as `agentshield-guard` on PyPI.
